verificationMethod: Separate second full-byte read pass over every declared record, with independently calculated SHA256, byte counts, modes, and exact filename-set comparison. No candidate execution.
remainingRootOwnedWork: Fresh import/source/build/dependency/slot/lifetime bindings, capture, closed raw seal/extraction, one native audit, and feature disposition.
limitations: Static packet readback only. Finite PIDFD process observation does not exclude an unobserved final fork/reparent; root owns lifetime disposition. No cgroup or global descendant-absence gate.
